summary: Official first-party sources establish Thái Bình local land-registration custody and VBDLIS deployment, but no anonymous current parcel endpoint, schema, CRS, safe native ID, or polygon geometry was verified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Vietnamese discovery was performed and recorded in the city record. GET to the official VBDLIS landing page returned HTTP 200 and its current JavaScript/static content was inspected without exposing a parcel API. GET to the official MPLIS entry route returned a restricted login wall; no credentials or further authenticated access was attempted. The official provincial service procedure documents cadastral-map extracts and land-database updating by Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai / its branch. No exact-point query was run because no verified anonymous parcel endpoint existed.
cityOrLocalCustodian: Sở Tài nguyên và Môi trường Thái Bình and Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai / its city branch are locally evidenced by official VBDLIS and provincial procedure pages. This is custodian/procedure evidence, not proof of an open citywide parcel layer.
routesAttempted: All attempted first-party routes, methods, bounded outcomes, and scope limits are recorded in city-3687-th-i-b-nh.json.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel/object ID when independently verified
schemaAndCrs: Unverified: no live anonymous parcel response was returned.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not performed against a verified parcel endpoint; no absence inference.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Thái Bình cadastral-custody discovery and bounded public-service review.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local registry/procedure and VBDLIS deployment evidence only; no parcel geometry.

uncertainty: The login wall and absent anonymous parcel route are access limitations, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence. The exact WUP point was preserved without shifting it. One preliminary diagnostic request used curl -k; it was not relied on for qualification and no TLS exception is authorized or retained.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
integrationDisposition: Research packet only; not source integration or admission. No registry/catalog/runtime files were changed.
